summary: Draw It In, rebuilt Klein-only: crop, edit, stitch - no render phase, no paste, no mask

Context measurement DONE, 7 Klein 9B runs on a 75px scribble. Governing variable is scribble px after 1MP normalise, not the extend factor: threshold ~200px, crop_MP <= (scribble_px/200)^2, sweet spot ~243px. Law 1 does NOT transfer (no blown-out patch at any rung incl 1x). Failure is at the WIDE end and is anchoring, not legibility; whole-image is destructive (deleted the woman, fused the tiger into the man). No absolute minimum drawn size - the crop manufactures resolution, so the 96px ControlNet ink floor does not carry over.

Stitch half measured off the same runs, no GPU. SECOND variable found: the return box must be >=1.6x the drawn bbox (2.2x with margin) or the rendered subject is sliced - the model renders around and beyond the drawing. With an adequate box a hard zero-feather paste on uniform sand measures ~5.5/255 luma step, so Law 2 is far milder here than the doc worst case and the feather is not load-bearing. Also recorded: edge luma metrics measure content as often as seams.

Crab / upscale-the-source question answered: redundant on this route because InpaintCropImproved normalises the crop to ~1MP however small the region is. A 75px scribble in a 0.008MP crop still produced a grounded figure with contact shading - the crab failure did not reproduce at any rung. Residual that DID move: the return box must contain the shadow, and that is scene-dependent (low sun = long shadow), so the 1.6x floor is for the subject only. NEW: seam visibility is context-dependent - the 2x render shows a visible rectangle where 3.5x does not, so within the working window choose the WIDEST crop that still anchors, not the tightest.
maturity in-progress, ownership written to files.json (12 paths, from the continue brief).
Ownership widened to 15 paths: the rack test that had to move off this flow, plus two docs the rebuild made factually wrong (blending-into-a-photo Law 1, paint-gizmo's read of the paint layer).
Phases 1-3 done: graph rebuilt (68 -> 34 nodes), app surface swept, docs rewritten.

729 node tests, 26 desktop tests, lint and release:check all pass. 5 live runs on 48188 across 4 cases: pixels outside the user's box are BIT-IDENTICAL on every run, the subject is complete at a 2.2x box, the ink is gone, and a cartoon prompt styled the SUBJECT only. Answered the brief's last open question - a 7.3x crop upscale stitches cleanly on textured ground; what shows is Law 2 over sky/water. One defect, 1 of 2 seeds: a casterless shadow blob under style load.
maturity validating - the remaining DoD item is Fabio's own run in the app (verify mode user-ux).

Fabio's app runs found a VINTAGE-PLATE SEAM the agent runs could not: the model restores a faded photo, so the returned patch is de-faded (+9.5/+5.5/+2.6 RGB) and re-contrasted, top-edge luma step 3.60 vs the photo's own 0.39. A bigger box did not help and a feather cannot - it is a whole-patch shift. Fixed with KJNodes ColorMatch (mkl, strength 1, ref = the original crop) before the stitch: simulated on his own output, then verified live at 3.60 -> -0.20. 737/737 node tests.
Graph 34 -> 35 nodes. Law 2 amended in blending-into-a-photo.md: severity tracks the plate's grade, not background uniformity.
